scope: Bounded evaluation configuration reads, execution concurrency/cancellation and controlled report/comparison races. Local development packages only.
assertions: Six concurrent identical submissions start one command; only four distinct active operations are admitted and the fifth creates no record.
Real worker cancellation settles; simulated progress IPC retains the newest 256 events only.
Configuration growing to 4 MiB after descriptor stat reads exactly 1 MiB plus one overflow byte, closes its descriptor and creates no record.
Short reads are retried, exactly 1 MiB is accepted, oversized/nonregular input is refused, and read errors close descriptors.
A real POSIX named pipe without a writer is rejected without waiting; no Windows/Linux execution proof claimed.
Frozen configurations use the same byte budget during report verification.
Early and late cancellation never becomes completed; changed engine environment rejects a synthetic agent run.
Subject/suite/runtime binding rejects tampered plans even after the test updates the stored file hash.
Plan/result changes between verification and copying, and invalid result keys are rejected; comparison temporary directories are removed.
Two real comparisons interleaved across the transaction boundary produce one diagnostic receipt.
limitations: Only macOS executed. Windows/Linux and native desktop acceptance remain pending.
Progress messages and specific file/store boundary interleavings are injected; command execution, cancellation, file copies, named pipe and receipt persistence are real.
Installed boundary tests select the compiled service from the installed package but use source fixture-store utilities; isolated whole-package startup has separate evidence.
Byte-read ceilings are measured; peak RSS and production latency are not measured here.
Global coverage registration and full-goal incremental coverage remain incomplete; the baseline was not changed.
Runtime 0.12.131/Eval 0.1.5 are mutable local development snapshots; no commit, push, publication or installed-plugin upgrade.
